name: Stephanie S. Kelly
office: Circuit Court Judge, 5th Subcircuit (Vacancy of Ross)

items.text: Stephanie S. Kelly is a Cook County Circuit Court judge in the First Municipal District, appointed in August 2026. Admitted to the Illinois bar in 2001, she has been Interim Senior Labor & Employment Counsel at Major, Lindsay & Africa since 2023. She previously worked as Vice President, General Counsel and Chief Compliance Officer at Chicago State University until late 2020.
